name: Tsukamoto Kaori
source:
[url=/c13501]Ririsu[/url]'s mother. Kaori is the owner of a youthful appearance, young enough to pass through as Ririsu's older sister. She usually has a mild temperament, but she tends to show motherly playfulness towards Ririsu. She also appears to be a crying drunk.

In Memo Off 6: T-Wave (In this game she made a voice only appearance): 
She is living with [url=/c14762]Yuugo[/url] (the dating itself has started a few years ago). This relationship has caused a major conflict between Kaori and Ririsu, making the later move in with her grandmother Fumiko, and away from her mother.

In Memo Off 6: Next Relation: 
The relationships conflict between the parents and the children of the two families (Yuugo and [url=/c13500]Shio[/url], Kaori and Ririsu) has been already settled. They are all living together in peace.
